About this design preview

The cabinet arrangement and all 33 source faces come from your supplied SketchUp model. Two design options: Option 1 has aqua/mint high-gloss solid fronts, Option 2 has beige high-gloss solid fronts; both are handleless with the same wood, glass and lighting. Wooden mica is used only inside the open areas: the wicker-basket unit, the open box on the counter and the lit undersides of the corner wall units. The identification colours are available under Reference colours.

Brown: shutters with shelves. Peach: cutlery tandem. Yellow: thali basket tandem. Green: oil pull-out. Light blue: S-corner. Dark blue: rice basket. Lavender: open unit with two wicker baskets. Mid blue: black tinted glass wall shutters with concealed lights and one glass shelf. Pink: normal wall shutter. Hardware and countertop colour are a design visualisation and still to be confirmed.
